name: percepta
description: Percepta — Plataforma SaaS de Análisis Inteligente de Video con IA modular

scripts.demo:seed-event: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U percepta -d percepta -c "SET app.current_org='00000000-0000-4000-b000-000000000001'; INSERT INTO events (occurred_at, organization_id, site_id, camera_id, ai_module_id, module_key, module_version, event_type, severity, confidence, dedup_key, detection) SELECT now(), '00000000-0000-4000-b000-000000000001', s.id, c.id, m.id, 'helmet-detection', '1.2.0', 'ppe.helmet_missing', 'high', 0.9312, 'demo-' || gen_random_uuid(), '{\"bbox\":[0.4,0.5,0.1,0.2],\"classLabel\":\"no_helmet\"}' FROM sites s, cameras c, ai_modules m WHERE m.module_key='helmet-detection' LIMIT 1;"
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U percepta -d percepta -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /migrations/0001_init.sql -f /migrations/0003_rls_hardening.sql -f /migrations/0007_personas.sql -f /migrations/0002_seed.sql -f /migrations/0004_admin_user.sql -f /migrations/0005_fall_feedback.sql -f /migrations/0008_control_accesos.sql -f /migrations/0009_foto_persona.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U percepta -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS percepta WITH (FORCE);" -c "CREATE DATABASE percepta OWNER percepta;" && pnpm db:migrate
